-- ============================================================================ -- Convert Aardwolf @color codes to Mudlet cecho format -- ============================================================================ function HSP.ColoursToMudlet(str) if not str then return "" end str = tostring(str) -- Map basic Aardwolf color codes to cecho color names local colorMap = { ["@r"] = "<ansiRed>", ["@R"] = "<ansiLightRed>", ["@g"] = "<ansiGreen>", ["@G"] = "<ansiLightGreen>", ["@b"] = "<ansiBlue>", ["@B"] = "<ansiLightBlue>", ["@c"] = "<ansiCyan>", ["@C"] = "<ansiLightCyan>", ["@y"] = "<ansiYellow>", ["@Y"] = "<ansiLightYellow>", ["@m"] = "<ansiMagenta>", ["@M"] = "<ansiLightMagenta>", ["@w"] = "<ansiWhite>", ["@W"] = "<white>", ["@D"] = "<ansiLightBlack>", } -- First handle the xterm codes used by this package. Unknown codes fall -- back to Mudlet's named white rather than emitting a numeric RGB tag. str = str:gsub("@[xX](%d%d%d)", function(num) local n = tonumber(num) return "<" .. HSP.ColoursToMudlet(str) .. "<reset>\n") end elseif level == "helpfile" or level == "helpfile2" then cecho(str .. local function hspDeletePreviousBlankLine(currentLineNumber) if type(currentLineNumber) ~= "number" or currentLineNumber <= 0 then return false end if type(getLines) ~= "function" or type(moveCursor) ~= "function" then return false end
local previousLineNumber = currentLineNumber - 1 local ok, previousLines = pcall(getLines, "main", previousLineNumber, previousLineNumber) local previousLine = ok and type(previousLines) == "table" and previousLines[1] or nil if previousLine == nil or not tostring(previousLine):match("^%s*$") then return false end
local moved, moveResult = pcall(moveCursor, "main", 0, previousLineNumber) if moved and moveResult ~= false then pcall(deleteLine) if type(moveCursorEnd) == "function" then pcall(moveCursorEnd, "main") elseif type(getLineCount) == "function" then local countOk, lineCount = pcall(getLineCount) if countOk and type(lineCount) == "number" then pcall(moveCursor, "main", 0, lineCount) end end return true end return false end
local function hspCurrentLineNumber() if type(getLineNumber) ~= "function" then return nil end local ok, number = pcall(getLineNumber) return ok and tonumber(number) or nil end
local function hspIsAardwolfPrompt(line) -- Match the normal [...] and combat <...> prompt wrappers, while requiring -- the hp/mn/mv fields so ordinary bracketed output is never suppressed. -- Prompt modifiers such as *[NOEXP]* may follow the closing wrapper. local body = line:match("^%s*%[(.-)%]") or line:match("^%s*<(.-)>") if body == nil then return false end return body:match("^%d+/%d+hp%s+%d+/%d+mn%s+%d+/%d+mv%s+") ~= nil end
local function hspSilenceDebug(message) local settings = Spellups["GL"] or {} if settings["Debug"] ~= "yes" then return end
-- Running cecho while a trigger is deleting or moving buffer rows can join -- unrelated lines. Defer these diagnostics until the trigger has finished. if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0.001, function() hadarprint(message, "debug") end) else hadarprint(message, "debug") end end
local function hspClearBlankCleanup() HSP.spellupBlankBudget = 0 HSP.spellupBlankDeadline = 0 HSP.spellupBlankCategory = nil HSP.spellupBlankReason = nil end
local function hspArmBlankCleanup(category, reason, budget) local requestedBudget = tonumber(budget) or 3 HSP.spellupBlankBudget = math.max(tonumber(HSP.spellupBlankBudget) or 0, requestedBudget) HSP.spellupBlankDeadline = os.time() + 5 HSP.spellupBlankCategory = category HSP.spellupBlankReason = reason end
local function hspBlankCleanupActive() if (tonumber(HSP.spellupBlankBudget) or 0) <= 0 then return false end if os.time() > (tonumber(HSP.spellupBlankDeadline) or 0) then hspClearBlankCleanup() return false end return true end
local hspHiddenProtocolTags = { affon = true, affoff = true, sfail = true, recon = true, recoff = true, skillgain = true, spellheaders = true, ["/spellheaders"] = true, recoveries = true, ["/recoveries"] = true, }
local function hspHiddenProtocolTag(line) local tag = line:match("^%{([^}%s]+)") return tag and hspHiddenProtocolTags[tag] and tag or nil end
function HSP.expectCastPrompt() local settings = Spellups["GL"] or {} if settings["silenceCasts"] ~= "yes" then return end
HSP.pendingCastPrompts = (tonumber(HSP.pendingCastPrompts) or 0) + 1 HSP.castPromptDeadline = os.time() + 10 hspArmBlankCleanup("casts", "outgoing HSP cast", 3) hspSilenceDebug("Queued HSP cast prompt suppression; pending: " .. HSP.pendingCastPrompts) end
local function hspConsumeExpectedCastPrompt(line) if not hspIsAardwolfPrompt(line) then return false end
local pending = tonumber(HSP.pendingCastPrompts) or 0 if pending <= 0 then return false end if os.time() > (tonumber(HSP.castPromptDeadline) or 0) then HSP.pendingCastPrompts = 0 HSP.castPromptDeadline = 0 hspSilenceDebug("HSP cast prompt suppression expired before a prompt arrived") return false end
HSP.pendingCastPrompts = pending - 1 if HSP.pendingCastPrompts == 0 then HSP.castPromptDeadline = 0 end return true end
function HSP.handleSpellupProse(line) line = tostring(line or "")
-- Aardwolf can terminate a GA-delimited prompt only when later output -- arrives. Keep this one-shot state without a wall-clock timeout, but cancel -- it on any nonblank inbound row so it can never consume an unrelated blank. if line:match("^%s*$") and HSP.awaitingCastPromptTerminator then deleteLine() HSP.awaitingCastPromptTerminator = false HSP.silencedBlankCount = HSP.silencedBlankCount + 1 hspSilenceDebug("Suppressed delayed HSP prompt terminator blank") return elseif not line:match("^%s*$") and HSP.awaitingCastPromptTerminator then HSP.awaitingCastPromptTerminator = false hspSilenceDebug("Cancelled delayed HSP prompt terminator wait on nonblank output") end
-- A cast can produce several adjacent separators, with omitted protocol tags -- interleaved between them. Consume a small bounded run and stop as soon as -- genuine visible output arrives. if line:match("^%s*$") then if hspBlankCleanupActive() then deleteLine() HSP.spellupBlankBudget = HSP.spellupBlankBudget - 1 HSP.silencedBlankCount = HSP.silencedBlankCount + 1 local reason = HSP.spellupBlankReason or "spellup output" local remaining = HSP.spellupBlankBudget if remaining <= 0 then hspClearBlankCleanup() end hspSilenceDebug("Suppressed adjacent blank row (" .. reason .. "); remaining budget: " .. remaining) end return end
local hiddenTag = hspHiddenProtocolTag(line) if hiddenTag then local settings = Spellups["GL"] or {} if hiddenTag == "affon" and settings["silenceCasts"] == "yes" then hspArmBlankCleanup("casts", "hidden affon row", 3) elseif hiddenTag == "affoff" and settings["silenceFalloffs"] == "yes" then hspArmBlankCleanup("falloffs", "hidden affoff row", 3) end -- All of these rows are deleted by HSP triggers, so they must not cancel a -- cleanup transaction that is waiting for their adjacent separators. return end
if hspConsumeExpectedCastPrompt(line) then local currentLineNumber = hspCurrentLineNumber() deleteLine() if hspDeletePreviousBlankLine(currentLineNumber) then HSP.silencedBlankCount = HSP.silencedBlankCount + 1 end HSP.silencedCastPromptCount = HSP.silencedCastPromptCount + 1 HSP.awaitingCastPromptTerminator = true hspArmBlankCleanup("casts", "HSP cast prompt", 3) hspSilenceDebug("Suppressed HSP cast prompt; pending: " .. HSP.pendingCastPrompts) return end
local settings = Spellups["GL"] or {} local suppress = (settings["silenceFalloffs"] == "yes" and HSP.spellupProse.falloffs[line]) or (settings["silenceCasts"] == "yes" and HSP.spellupProse.casts[line])
if suppress then local currentLineNumber = hspCurrentLineNumber()
deleteLine() if hspDeletePreviousBlankLine(currentLineNumber) then HSP.silencedBlankCount = HSP.silencedBlankCount + 1 end local category = HSP.spellupProse.falloffs[line] and "falloffs" or "casts" hspArmBlankCleanup(category, "suppressed " .. category .. " row", 3) return end
hspClearBlankCleanup() end
-- ============================================================================ -- Utility: string interpolation (adapted) -- ============================================================================ function interp(s, tab) if s == nil then hadarprint("<ansiLightRed>You forgot to fill in a message please use <ansiLightCyan>hsp help<ansiLightRed> and run the message commands to see which one.") return "" else return (s:gsub('($%b{})', function(w) return tab[w:sub(3, -2)] or w end)) end end
-- ============================================================================ -- Utility: table helpers (adapted from MUSHclient) -- ============================================================================ function table.find(val, tbl) tbl = tbl or {} if (tbl[val] ~= nil) then return tbl[val] end return nil end
function table.count(tbl) tbl = tbl or {} local tblcount = 0 for i,v in pairs(tbl) do tblcount = tblcount + 1 end return tblcount end
function contains(tableToSearch, value) if not tableToSearch then return false end for i,v in ipairs(tableToSearch) do if (v == value) then return true end end return false end
function HSP.isNoAuto(sn) local noAuto = Spellups["EX"] and Spellups["EX"]["noAuto"] return contains(noAuto, tonumber(sn)) end
function HSP.hasNoAuto() local noAuto = Spellups["EX"] and Spellups["EX"]["noAuto"] return noAuto ~= nil and next(noAuto) ~= nil end
function remove(tableToSearch, value) for i,v in ipairs(tableToSearch) do if (v == value) then table.remove(tableToSearch, i) return end end end
-- ============================================================================ -- Utility: split string -- ============================================================================ function HSP.split(str, sep, max) local parts = {} local count = 0 for part in str:gmatch("[^" .. (sep or "%s") .. "]+") do count = count + 1 if max and count >= max then parts[count] = str:sub(str:find(part, 1, true)) break end parts[count] = part end return parts end
-- ============================================================================ -- GMCP helper - access nested GMCP data by dot path -- ============================================================================ function HSP.gmcpval(path) local parts = HSP.split(path, ".") local current = gmcp for _, part in ipairs(parts) do if current == nil then return nil end current = current[part] end return current end
-- ============================================================================ -- State persistence (replaces MUSHclient GetVariable/SetVariable/SaveState) -- ============================================================================ function HSP.SaveState() Spellups["GL"]["initilized"] = "yes" table.save(HSP.savefile, Spellups) end
function HSP.LoadState() if io.open(HSP.savefile, "r") then table.load(HSP.savefile, Spellups) return true end return false end
-- ============================================================================ -- Timer management (replaces MUSHclient AddTimer/DeleteTimer) -- ============================================================================ function HSP.AddNamedTimer(name, hours, minutes, seconds, callback_name) HSP.DeleteNamedTimer(name) local total_secs = (hours or 0) * 3600 + (minutes or 0) * 60 + (seconds or 0) if total_secs <= 0 then return end HSP.timerIDs[name] = tempTimer(total_secs, function() HSP.timerIDs[name] = nil if _G[callback_name] then _G[callback_name](name) end end) end
function HSP.DeleteNamedTimer(name) if HSP.timerIDs[name] then killTimer(HSP.timerIDs[name]) HSP.timerIDs[name] = nil end end
-- ============================================================================ -- SendSpecial replacement - sends a command to MUD via channel -- ============================================================================ function HSP.SendSpecial(cmd) send(cmd) end
function HSP.updateCurrentState() local state = HSP.gmcpval("char.status.state") if state ~= nil then HSP.currentState = tonumber(state) or -1 end return HSP.currentState end
function HSP.isInCombat() return HSP.updateCurrentState() == 8 end
-- ============================================================================ -- GMCP Event Handler (replaces OnPluginBroadcast) -- ============================================================================ function HSP.onGMCPCharStatus() if not Spellups["GL"] then return end

-- handle disabled state if Spellups["GL"]["SpellsDisabled"] == "yes" then hadarprint("SpellsDisabled == yes", "debug") hadarprint(tostring(Spellups["GL"]["DisabledReason"]), "debug") if Spellups["GL"]["DisabledReason"] == "died" or Spellups["GL"]["DisabledReason"] == "failed" then HSP.currentmana = 0 if Spellups["GL"]["DisabledReason"] == "died" then Spellups["GL"]["DisabledReason"] = "died2" end else return end local mm = HSP.gmcpval("char.maxstats.maxmana") HSP.maxmana = tonumber(mm) or -1 local cm = HSP.gmcpval("char.vitals.mana") HSP.currentmana = tonumber(cm) or 0 local percentage = (HSP.maxmana * Spellups["GL"]["percEnable"] / 100) if HSP.currentmana >= percentage then if Spellups["GL"]["DisabledReason"] == "died2" or Spellups["GL"]["DisabledReason"] == "failed" then hadarprint("trying to recast", "debug") HSPDisable("disablespellsoff") cast_spells() end if Spellups["GL"]["failed"] >= 5 then Spellups["GL"]["failed"] = 0 HSPDisable("disablespellsoff") end end end end
function HSP.onGMCPCharVitals() local cm = HSP.gmcpval("char.vitals.mana") HSP.currentmana = tonumber(cm) or 0 end
function HSP.onGMCPCharMaxstats() local mm = HSP.gmcpval("char.maxstats.maxmana") HSP.maxmana = tonumber(mm) or -1 if HSP.maxmana == nil or HSP.maxmana == -1 then Spellups["EX"]["percentageStop"] = 0 else Spellups["EX"]["percentageStop"] = (HSP.maxmana * Spellups["EX"]["percentage"] / 100) end end
